what_this_is: Accuracy of OILTRACE's OWN ModelSegmenter chain (not the reference argmax path), on the author's held-out test split.

test_set.source: Krestenitis/MKLab M4D, standard held-out test split

note_on_convention: All IoU values here are GLOBAL (pooled confusion matrix) so the three rows are directly comparable. The published 61.549% uses the per-image-mean convention; the equivalent global figure for the reference argmax path is 53.101%.

1_reference_argmax.what: argmax over 5 classes — the author's evaluation path

3_full_pipeline.what: threshold + MIN_SLICK_AREA_PX=1500 contour filter — what OILTRACE actually detects

cost_of_pipeline_config.diagnosis: The 0.5 probability threshold costs almost nothing (-0.1 IoU). Essentially all the loss comes from MIN_SLICK_AREA_PX=1500, which discards 311 of 404 detected regions. The smallest genuine oil region in this test set is 426 px, so the 1500 px floor is above real slicks.

recommendation: Lower MIN_SLICK_AREA_PX (a value near 400 px would admit the smallest real slick in the benchmark). This is a tunable operating point, not a model limitation.

rgb_channel_check.note: 0 of 110 — these SAR images are greyscale, so OILTRACE's single-band read plus 3-channel replication is equivalent to reading the full image.
